changes.description: withTargetLock now uses canonical target identity via normalizeTargetForLocking() and a system-wide /var/lock/kvmctl directory instead of per-user os.UserCacheDir(), enabling cross-user device serialization

reason: Greptile review issue #1: per-user locks permit interleaving on same KVMD device across different OS users or containers. Fix: use canonical target identity (URL-based) and system-wide lock directory for proper serialization.
